experiment: E15 keyword categories: refining a UML3 semantic keyword in an extension library
setup: Trigger: run_tests.py --cameo on 2026-09-17 failed because the validation engine flagged UML3IDL with validateFeatureValueOverriding on UnionMetadata (':> DataTypeMetadata' with ':>> baseType = idlUnions ...'). Probes tests/cameo-negative/p06-keyword-overrides-bound-base.sysml (the failing shape, isolated) and p07-keyword-category.sysml (the category pattern: abstract metadata def UML3Core::DataTypeKind :> SemanticMetadata with baseType unbound; DataTypeMetadata and the probe keyword specialize it). Checks: probe load status, validation engine per package (validation-predictions.json), implied specializations Q06-Q09 (probe-effects.json), and the IDL views (svg-expectations.json: PaymentDetail, a #union, is drawn by ClassDiagram, whose filter now uses @DataTypeKind).

predictions.claim: p06 loads without builder errors (the load path reports parsing and linking only)
predictions.observation: p06 loaded with no builder errors (logs/cameo/cameo-probes-report.json, 2026-09-17 12:03)

predictions.claim: The validation engine flags UML3ProbeKeywordOverridesBase with validateFeatureValueOverriding on baseType
predictions.observation: UML3ProbeKeywordOverridesBase: ERROR validateFeatureValueOverriding on baseType, 'Cannot override a non-default value - the redefined feature already has a non-default value. Redefined feature(s): ref :>> baseType.'

predictions.claim: p07 loads and the validation engine reports no ERROR for UML3ProbeKeywordCategory: an abstract metadata def specializing SemanticMetadata with baseType unbound is legal, and binding baseType below it overrides nothing
predictions.observation: p07 loaded; the validation engine reported no failure for UML3ProbeKeywordCategory

predictions.claim: #probeChoice attribute def Selection specializes ProbeChoice and UML3Core::DataType (Q06, Q07); #dataType attribute def Amount still specializes DataType and not ProbeChoice (Q08, Q09)
predictions.observation: Q06, Q07, Q08 true and Q09 false as predicted (verifyImpliedSpecializations)

predictions.claim: UML3IDL and UML3Core are not flagged after UnionMetadata and DataTypeMetadata specialize DataTypeKind
predictions.observation: run_tests.py --cameo: validation engine passed with UML3IDL and UML3Core not flagged; the 2026-09-17 failure is gone

predictions.claim: A view filter '@DataTypeKind' selects elements marked #dataType and #union: shop_order_views::idlTypes draws PaymentDetail and Money
predictions.observation: shop_order_views::idlTypes (TREE) and idlTypeDetails (UNDEFINED) draw PaymentDetail and Money with SVG labels, 0 overlaps (logs/cameo/view-diagrams.txt)

conclusion: An extension keyword that refines a UML3 semantic keyword specializes an abstract keyword category (UML3Core::DataTypeKind) instead of the keyword; check_rules.py R15 reports the overriding form locally.
